definitions.explanation: Commands or guidance given to tell someone what to do.

examples.japanese: {上司|じょうし}から{指示|しじ}を{受|う}けた。
examples.english: I received instructions from my supervisor.

examples.japanese: {指示|しじ}{通|どお}りにやってください。
examples.english: Please do it according to the instructions.

notes:
{指示|しじ} refers to directions or orders given by someone in authority.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {指示|しじ}を{出|だ}す (give instructions)
- {指示|しじ}を{受|う}ける (receive instructions)
- {指示|しじ}に{従|したが}う (follow instructions)
- {指示|しじ}{通|どお}り (as instructed)
- {指示|しじ}{書|しょ} (written instructions, directive)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {命令|めいれい}: order, command (stronger)
- {案内|あんない}: guidance, directions (gentler)
